name: Furlbrow's Deed
summary: The Furlbrows flee their farm as Defias bandits carry their land grant through Elwynn Forest. Returning the deed to Farmer Furlbrow near the Westfall border preserves the couple’s claim to their stolen homestead.

sections.title: A Clue on Stolen Paper
sections.body: Defias bandits in Elwynn carry a land deed signed by Theodore and Verna Furlbrow. A crude note on its back says they drove the elderly farmer from his property, then carried the document across the river into Elwynn to copy it and forge claims to other seized land. The note says the Furlbrows were stranded just over the border, beside the road, after their wagon broke.

sections.title: The Plight of Westfall's Farmers
sections.body: The Defias have driven dozens of families from their ancestral land in Westfall. With Stormwind’s army absent and the realm’s resources strained, the Brotherhood uses force and false claims to seize the kingdom’s breadbasket. Theodore and Verna are leaving their farm for safety, but their lawful deed preserves their claim if order ever returns to the province.

faq.q: Where do I find this deed?
faq.answer: Defias Brotherhood bandits carry the deed in southern and western Elwynn Forest, including near Jerod's Landing and in local camps.

aliases: where to turn in furlbrows deed
faq.answer: Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna are stranded beside their broken wagon on the main road just inside Westfall, shortly after you cross the bridge west from Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why did the Defias want the deed in the first place?
aliases: why did bandits steal the deed
faq.answer: A note on the back says the bandits mean to copy Furlbrow's legitimate deed and forge claims to other properties, strengthening their hold on stolen farms with false paperwork.

faq.q: Are the Furlbrows returning to their farm?
aliases: what happens to the furlbrow farm
faq.answer: The couple is fleeing the region because of lawlessness and bandit attacks. Holding their deed ensures they can legally reclaim their land if Westfall is ever pacified.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind protecting these farms?
faq.answer: Stormwind's protection has faltered amid King Varian Wrynn's sudden disappearance and domestic political tension. With royal resources focused on the capital, outer territories like Westfall are left to face the surging Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What is the connection between Elwynn and Westfall in this quest?
faq.answer: The Defias network reaches from Elwynn Forest across the river into Westfall, showing how far its reach extends into the kingdom's core territories.

angles.text: The Furlbrows' plight shows the Stormwind crown has failed to protect its taxpaying citizens beyond the capital's fortified walls.
As a paladin, returning a stolen deed to refugees honors your holy vows to defend the defenseless and bring justice to lawless borderlands.
